rules: Keep all six canonical segment_id values and canonical transcript text unchanged.
A realization may use one continuous or mixed panel timeline in which neighboring speaker audio overlaps across the S002-S005 region.
Stable segment mappings identify each segment's primary canonical utterance interval; overlap may extend across a segment boundary and does not require an isolated clean clip.
Overlap/interruption is recorded as realization/evidence-condition metadata for the affected S002-S005 context, not as a new learner-state dimension or standalone score.
The scored learner response remains CORE_COMPREHENSION / discourse-structure-and-detail evidence grounded in MAN-0844-A-COMP-01.
Do not score whether the learner can name, imitate or explicitly detect overlap unless a future separately authorized Practice target adds that construct.

For learner playback, full-panel playback is the canonical evidence condition. Segment-addressable replay may use bounded context windows/pre-roll/post-roll so the actual overlap remains audible; such replay is support-aware and weaker than first-pass full-context evidence.
If a segment replay strips away the overlap, observations from that replay must not be tagged as overlap-condition evidence.
No textual content from an overlapping neighboring speaker is added to the focus segment's canonical transcript or answer key; transcript identity remains Curriculum-owned.
minimum_realization_requirements: At least one actual audible overlap/interruption event involving the S002-S005 panel region.
Versioned mixed-timeline asset or runtime adapter with deterministic mapping back to the stable canonical segment IDs.
Explicit affected-segment/context metadata identifying where overlap is present.
Technical integrity/decode checks and exact lesson/version binding.
Evidence that the overlap event is actually present in the produced realization; sequential isolated voices alone do not satisfy the condition.

scoring_and_evidence_boundary.first_pass: Full-context independent comprehension under the overlap condition is strongest evidence.
scoring_and_evidence_boundary.replay: Context-preserving replay is assisted evidence and must be logged as such.
scoring_and_evidence_boundary.clean_replay: A clean isolated replay may support repair but cannot count as overlap-condition evidence.
scoring_and_evidence_boundary.mastery: Success does not create an 'overlap mastery' state; update the existing comprehension dimension only.
scoring_and_evidence_boundary.transfer: Transfer requires novel input preserving the comprehension construct; overlap may be retained as a transfer facet/condition when relevant.

historical_next_action.requires: Implement a versioned MAN-0844 realization using the approved continuous/mixed timeline representation. Preserve canonical segment IDs/text, provide deterministic segment/context mapping and actual overlap evidence for S002-S005, then route the exact realization back to Practice #2 only for final realization-dependent PRACTICE_READY/CONTRACT_VALID. Reuse existing support/rights/runtime machinery. Do not change frozen contracts.
